title: The Morning Run — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 104bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning Pete ocean
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The morning run begins at first light when the harbour's half asleep
The Pelican slips the moorings and heads out toward the deep
Pete at the wheel, the clients in their jackets at the rail
Reading the horizon for the signs that never fail

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La salida matutina comienza al primer rayo de luz
[The morning run begins at first light]
El Pelícano desliza las amarras y va hacia el sur
[The Pelican slips the moorings and heads south]
Pete al timón, los clientes en chalecos en la borda
[Pete at the wheel, clients in jackets at the rail]
Leyendo el horizonte para las señales que acuerda
[Reading the horizon for the signs that agree]

[Chorus — English]
The morning run, the morning run
Out of Fremantle harbour with the rising of the sun
Pete knows what's running and where the ledge will be
The morning run is what the free look like when they're free
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La sortie matinale commence au premier rayon du soleil
[The morning run begins at the first ray of sun]
Le Pélican largue les amarres et part pour la mer vermeille
[The Pelican slips the moorings and heads for the vermillion sea]
Pete au gouvernail, les clients à la rambarde
[Pete at the helm, clients at the rail]
Il lit l'horizon — c'est sa méthode et sa garde
[He reads the horizon — it is his method and his watch]

[Outro — All three languages]
The morning run… La salida matutina… La sortie matinale
Pete knows the ocean — Pete conoce el océano — Pete connaît l'océan
That's my boy
